info.title: Sessions API
info.description: HTTP API for authentication, organization-scoped inference configuration, and agent runtime requests.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Sessions, messages, state snapshots, and session-state settings routes.

get.description: Lists active, unarchived sessions owned by the current user in the active organization.

post.description: Creates an organization-scoped session owned by the current user.

get.description: Returns an owned session with messages and versioned state snapshots.

patch.description: Updates owned session metadata such as title or model selection.

post.description: Appends a message to an owned session and enforces server-side byte limits.

requestBody.description: Message role, content, and optional metadata.

post.description: Appends a JSON state snapshot to an owned session and enforces server-side byte limits.

requestBody.description: Snapshot kind and JSON state payload.

post.description: Atomically removes messages after a boundary and removes state snapshots that reference deleted messages.

requestBody.description: Message ID to retain as the final message, or null to remove all messages.

post.description: Archives an owned session so it no longer appears in the active session list and becomes eligible for physical purge according to organization retention settings.

get.description: Returns organization-level session-state settings for the active organization.

patch.description: Updates organization-level session-state settings. The caller must be an organization admin.

post.description: Atomically persists the user turn and immutable run configuration, then streams replayable run events. Reusing an idempotency key with the exact request attaches to the same run.

requestBody.description: User turn, model selection, and caller-stable idempotency key.

UserRole.description: Membership role for a user within an organization.

OrganizationInviteStatus.description: Lifecycle status for an organization invite.

AuthRefreshReason.description: Debug reason for an auth refresh invalidation event.

type.description: Event type. Clients should force-refresh auth state for this event.

reason.description: Reason supplied for logging and diagnostics; client behavior is the same for every reason.

WorkspaceMode.description: Workspace mode that owns a model default.

SessionMessageRole.description: Role for a persisted session message.

RegisterAccountRequest.description: Creates an email/password account and an initial organization.

email.description: Email address used for sign-in and verification.

password.description: Password for the account. Must be between 8 and 512 characters.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the app. Defaults to the email prefix.

organizationName.description: Initial organization name. Defaults to an organization derived from the display name.

EmailVerificationRequired.description: Registration response indicating the email verification gate.

emailVerificationRequired.description: Always true for password registration responses.

email.description: Email address that must be verified before login succeeds.

organizationId.description: Optional organization to enter when the user belongs to more than one organization.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Completes email verification using the token delivered to the mailbox.

RequestPasswordResetRequest.description: Requests a password-reset email without revealing whether the account exists.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Replaces the password and revokes every active session.

password.description: Replacement password. Must be between 8 and 512 characters.

LogoutRequest.description: Logout request body. Send an empty JSON object.

RefreshSessionRequest.description: Refresh request body. Send an empty JSON object; the refresh cookie supplies the session.

LogoutAllSessionsRequest.description: Logout-all request body. Send an empty JSON object.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name to store for the authenticated user.

name.description: Organization display name to store for the active organization.

OrganizationSummary.description: Organization membership visible to the current user.

ListOrganizationsResponse.description: Organizations available to the current user.

activeOrganizationId.description: Active organization for the current session, or null when one must be created.

organizations.description: Organizations the current user belongs to.

organizationId.description: Organization to make active for the current session.

name.description: Display name for the new organization.

DeleteCurrentOrganizationRequest.description: Delete-organization request body. Send an empty JSON object.

requiresOrganization.description: False when another organization is active after deletion.
True when the user must create a new organization.

DeleteCurrentOrganizationResponse.description: Delete-organization response with the next session state.

RemoveOrganizationMemberRequest.description: Removes a member from the active organization.

role.description: Role to grant when the invite is accepted.

expiresInDays.description: Optional expiration window in days. Defaults to 14.

RespondToOrganizationInviteRequest.description: Accepts or declines an organization invitation.

token.description: Secret token from the invitation email.

CurrentSession.description: Session profile returned to authenticated clients.

membership.description: Membership connecting the user to the active organization.

emailVerified.description: Whether the email principal has been verified.

role.description: Role granted to the user in the active organization.

AccessSession.description: Login or refresh response containing an access token and session profile.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer JWT for API and backing-service requests.

ApiTokenScope.description: Capability granted to an API token.

ApiToken.description: Organization-scoped API token metadata. The secret is never returned here.

prefix.description: Non-secret token prefix shown for identification.

createdByUserId.description: User that created the token, or null if that user was deleted.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp, or null for no expiration.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent observed use, coalesced to reduce write load.

revokedAt.description: Revocation timestamp, or null while active.

ListApiTokensResponse.description: API tokens visible to an organization admin.

tokens.description: Active and expired organization API tokens. Revoked tokens are omitted.

scopes.description: One or more capabilities to grant.

expiresInDays.description: Optional expiration between 1 and 365 days. Omit for no expiration.

CreateApiTokenResponse.description: Created API token and its one-time secret.

ModelDefaults.description: Default model selection for each workspace mode.

code.description: Default model selection for code workflows.

work.description: Default model selection for work workflows.

agents.description: Default model selection for agent workflows.

InferenceModelCapabilities.description: Partial capability facts. Omitted fields are unknown, not unsupported.

interfaces.description: Provider interfaces known to accept this model.

inputModalities.description: Input modalities positively identified for this model.

outputModalities.description: Output modalities positively identified for this model.

features.description: Optional model features positively identified by the provider.

InferenceModelStatus.description: Model availability exposed by a configured inference provider.

enabled.description: Whether users can select this model.

configured.description: Whether the provider has a stored API key.

enabled.description: Whether the provider can be used for inference.

baseUrl.description: Base URL used for provider requests.

models.description: Models currently known for this provider.

InferenceConfig.description: Complete inference configuration for the active organization.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns this inference configuration.

providers.description: Configured inference providers for the organization.

apiKey.description: Provider API key. Stored server-side and never returned.

baseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL override for providers that support it.

enabled.description: Whether the provider can be used for inference.

RefreshInferenceProviderModelsRequest.description: Refreshes the models available from an inference provider.

UpdateInferenceModelRequest.description: Updates availability for a provider model.

enabled.description: Whether users can select this model.

UpdateInferenceModelDefaultRequest.description: Updates the default model selection for a workspace mode.

modelSelection.description: Model selection in provider/model form as returned by inference configuration.

id.description: Organization-scoped model identifier accepted by the compatibility endpoints.

created.description: Creation timestamp. Lush returns zero because provider discovery does not expose this value consistently.

data.description: Enabled models for the active organization.

model.description: Organization-scoped model identifier returned by the models endpoint.

OpenAICompatibleRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible request. Endpoint-specific fields are passed through to the selected provider.

agentId.description: Agent identifier that owns or interprets this session.

stateBytes.description: Stored session bytes counted against the session limit.

archivedAt.description: Archive timestamp, or null when active.

metadata.description: Small JSON metadata associated with the message.

byteSize.description: Bytes counted against the session limit.
Bytes counted against the session limit.

Session.description: Owned session with messages and state snapshots.

sessions.description: Active, unarchived sessions owned by the current user.

title.description: Optional title. Defaults to an untitled session.

agentId.description: Agent identifier that owns or interprets this session.

AppendSessionMessageRequest.description: Appends a message to a session.

AppendSessionStateRequest.description: Appends a state snapshot to a session.

TruncateSessionRequest.description: Truncates a session at a message boundary.

afterMessageId.description: Final message to retain, or null to remove all messages.

ArchiveSessionRequest.description: Archive-session request body. Send an empty JSON object.

retentionSeconds.description: Retention window for physically purging soft-deleted sessions.

AgentChatMessage.description: Chat message sent to or produced by an agent.

AgentChatRequest.description: Streaming chat request for a session-backed chat.

sessionId.description: Session identifier whose persisted messages are used as agent context.

messages.description: Client-side conversation snapshot or delta. The API reconciles this with persisted session messages before invoking the agent.

AgentPromptRequest.description: Streaming prompt request for one-off agent operations.

messages.description: Conversation messages to send to the agent.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-stable key for exact start retries.

originMessageId.description: Existing retained user message to reuse for a retried turn.
